summaryZh: 荷兰德伦特省一家农场在缬草和紫锥菊种植中应用Ullmanna智能锄草机，该设备通过算法识别作物与杂草，行内除草率达55%，行间达73%。尽管算法训练耗时超预期，但提前启动有助于更好区分作物与杂草。文章展示了AI除草技术在药用作物种植中的实际应用效果与投资回报。
featuredReason: 本文展示了AI视觉锄草机在药用作物中的实际应用效果与投资回报，对智慧畜牧行业了解跨领域精准农业技术具有参考价值。

‘Ullmanna hoe pays for itself within a few years’

 13-08 | Smart farming | Article

Mart Everts, partner of Gerard Lanting, walks alongside the newly purchased Ullmanna hoe. He is inspecting the result of hoeing in valerian. The hoe removes 55% of the weeds in the row and 73% between the rows. Photo: Jan Willem Schouten

 This season, the Ullmanna hoe is operating in valerian and echinacea at Gerard Lanting’s farm in the Dutch village of Oosterhesselen (Drenthe province). Training the algorithms is taking more time than expected. Starting on time certainly helps to distinguish valerian properly from weeds.
